profile_text.body:
Palantir is a for-profit public company founded in 2003 and headquartered in Palo Alto, trading on public markets under the ticker PLTR. The company describes itself as building software that empowers organizations to effectively integrate their data, decisions, and operations, with the tagline "Foundational Software of Tomorrow. Delivered Today."

Palantir's principal AI product tracked on this site is Palantir AIP, an enterprise AI platform in the Data and Analytics AI category. The platform is built around an Ontology-based governance approach and is noted for its focus on defense and intelligence use cases as well as influence over high-stakes decisions.

No litigation or MCP server registrations are currently held for Palantir in this site's records. The company's SEC Central Index Key is 0001321655, and its profile was last verified on September 3, 2026.
